messages:
Maya: Heads up from today's dashboard review — compact metric rows are misleading: legends wrap, and extreme spikes in the mini-sparkline get clipped so rows sometimes read as flat. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.example/ux/compact-misread.png

Ivy: We should avoid per-row autoscaling by default; users rely on consistent scales to compare rows. Idea: render an 'overflow' marker at the edge of the sparkline when the true peak exceeds preview bounds.

Sam (Design): I like the marker. UX notes: make it subtle but discoverable, and provide a hover/focus popup with exact peak value and timestamp. For legends, force single-line truncation + an accessible expansion on focus.

Theo (Eng): Implementation: svg sparkline preview + an extra <line> element for the overflow marker. We'll attach aria-describedby to the marker and surface a small popup DOM node. CSS text-overflow will handle legend truncation.

Ivy: One accessibility constraint: the marker must be keyboard reachable and not change tab order — maybe let it be focusable via chart focus + arrow keys or Enter. Popup must be announced to screen readers.

Sam (Design): Draft popup copy: "Peak: 3.2s (220% of median) \u2014 Time: 15:42 UTC". For truncated legend hover: "Series: payment latency \u2014 unit p95 (ms) \u2014 press Enter for details". Screen-reader-only text should mirror that.

accessibility-bot: checklist: marker role="button" or role="link"? Use role="button" with aria-pressed=false for toggleable details. Ensure contrast >= 3:1 and popup has aria-live="polite" when opened by keyboard.

Theo (Eng): Good call. We'll use role="button" and aria-controls pointing to the popup. Performance note: render markers only for rows where preview.max < real.max to avoid clutter; batching updates for 100+ rows.

Maya: Decision: ship legend truncation + accessible expand, add overflow marker + keyboard popup, defer per-row autoscale. Action items: Sam  finalize microcopy & a11y spec, Theo  spike branch with SVG marker + aria, Ivy  run quick keyboard test. Target: prototype by end of week.

Theo (Eng): I'll open a WIP PR and post the demo link here.

Maya: Thanks team :thumbsup:
